coverage.boundedSampleReason: Two regimes. Nebraska because it is the state the game can actually hold a legislative election in, so the rule reaches a real campaign; Minnesota because a second state's differently-shaped obligation is what stops one statute's structure being mistaken for the shape of campaign law. No other state's campaign-finance law has been read, and none is implied by these.
coverage.universeDescription: Three obligations: two from Minn. Stat. § 10A.105, subd. 1, and one from Neb. Rev. Stat. § 49-1446. Two states, two provisions.
